units.name: value accessors
units.summary: Typed accessors and version reporting for cJSON items: each guards on item type and returns a sentinel when the type does not match.
units.explain: Typed accessors and version reporting for cJSON items: each guards on item type and returns a sentinel when the type does not match. cJSON_GetErrorPtr returns a pointer into the static global_error record (meaningful only right after a failed parse). cJSON_GetStringValue returns valuestring only when cJSON_IsString holds, else…
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(const char *) cJSON_GetErrorPtr(void)

units.name: case_insensitive_strcmp
units.summary: Case-insensitive byte comparison used for object-key lookups.
units.explain: Case-insensitive byte comparison used for object-key lookups. If either pointer is NULL it returns 1 (so a NULL key never matches anything); identical pointers return 0.
units.sig: static int case_insensitive_strcmp(const unsigned char *string1, const unsigned char *string2)

units.name: allocator plumbing
units.summary: Allocator abstraction for the whole library: an internal_hooks struct of allocate/deallocate/reallocate function pointers, MSVC-only thin wrappers (internal_malloc, internal_free, internal_realloc) s…
units.explain: Allocator abstraction for the whole library: an internal_hooks struct of allocate/deallocate/reallocate function pointers, MSVC-only thin wrappers (internal_malloc, internal_free, internal_realloc) satisfying the dllimport address-of restriction, and the global_hooks instance initialized to malloc/free/realloc.
units.sig: struct internal_hooks

units.name: cJSON_strdup
units.summary: Duplicates a NUL-terminated byte string using the supplied hooks.
units.explain: Duplicates a NUL-terminated byte string using the supplied hooks. Returns NULL for a NULL input or allocation failure; otherwise allocates strlen+1 bytes, memcpy's the string including the terminator, and returns it. The caller must release the buffer with the same hooks' deallocate.
units.sig: static unsigned char* cJSON_strdup(const unsigned char* string, const internal_hooks * const hooks)

units.name: cJSON_InitHooks
units.summary: Installs custom allocation hooks into global_hooks.
units.explain: Installs custom allocation hooks into global_hooks. A NULL argument resets all three hooks to malloc/free/realloc.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(void) cJSON_InitHooks(cJSON_Hooks* hooks)

units.name: cJSON_New_Item
units.summary: Allocates one cJSON node via the given hooks and memsets it to zero, so type is cJSON_Invalid and all pointers are NULL.
units.explain: Allocates one cJSON node via the given hooks and memsets it to zero, so type is cJSON_Invalid and all pointers are NULL. Returns NULL when allocation fails.
units.sig: static cJSON *cJSON_New_Item(const internal_hooks * const hooks)

units.name: cJSON_Delete
units.summary: Frees an item and its entire ->next sibling chain.
units.explain: Frees an item and its entire ->next sibling chain.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(void) cJSON_Delete(cJSON *item)

units.name: internal utilities
units.summary: Small shared helpers.
units.explain: Small shared helpers. get_decimal_point returns localeconv()->decimal_point[0] only when ENABLE_LOCALES is defined, otherwise always '.'. update_offset advances a printbuffer's offset by strlen of the string starting at the current offset, ignoring NULL buffers. compare_double treats doubles as equal when |a-b| <= max(|a|,|b|)*…
units.sig: static unsigned char get_decimal_point(void)

units.name: parse_number
units.summary: Parses a JSON number at the buffer offset into item via strtod.
units.explain: Parses a JSON number at the buffer offset into item via strtod. NULL buffer or content returns false. It copies the maximal run of digits, '+', '-', 'e', 'E' and '.' characters (stopping at any other byte or buffer end) into a hook-allocated temporary buffer, replacing '.' with the locale decimal point when a '.' was seen.
units.sig: static cJSON_bool parse_number(cJSON * const item, parse_buffer * const input_buffer)

units.name: cJSON_SetNumberHelper
units.summary: Stores a double into an existing number item and returns the stored value.
units.explain: Stores a double into an existing number item and returns the stored value. A NULL object returns NAN. valueint is saturated to INT_MAX or INT_MIN when out of range, otherwise truncated; valuedouble is assigned and returned.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(double) cJSON_SetNumberHelper(cJSON *object, double number)

units.name: cJSON_SetValuestring
units.summary: Replaces the string of a non-reference cJSON_String item.
units.explain: Replaces the string of a non-reference cJSON_String item. Returns NULL when object is NULL, the item is not a string or is flagged cJSON_IsReference, or either the existing or new valuestring is NULL.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(char*) cJSON_SetValuestring(cJSON *object, const char *valuestring)

units.name: ensure
units.summary: Grows a printbuffer so at least 'needed' bytes plus a terminator are writable at the current offset, returning a write pointer there.
units.explain: Grows a printbuffer so at least 'needed' bytes plus a terminator are writable at the current offset, returning a write pointer there. Returns NULL when p or p->buffer is NULL, when offset is already at or past length, or when needed exceeds INT_MAX.
units.sig: static unsigned char* ensure(printbuffer * const p, size_t needed)

units.name: print_number
units.summary: Renders an item's double into the printbuffer.
units.explain: Renders an item's double into the printbuffer. NULL output_buffer returns false. NaN or infinity prints 'null'.
units.sig: static cJSON_bool print_number(const cJSON * const item, printbuffer * const output_buffer)

units.name: parse_hex4
units.summary: Parses exactly four hexadecimal digits into an unsigned int, accumulating nibbles left to right.
units.explain: Parses exactly four hexadecimal digits into an unsigned int, accumulating nibbles left to right. Any byte outside 0-9, A-F, a-f returns 0 immediately, so 0 is both a possible value and the error sentinel; the caller cannot distinguish '\u0030' from an invalid digit by return value alone.
units.sig: static unsigned parse_hex4(const unsigned char * const input)

units.name: utf16_literal_to_utf8
units.summary: Converts a \uXXXX escape (or a surrogate pair \uXXXX\uXXXX) at input_pointer into UTF-8 bytes written through *output_pointer, returning the consumed escape length (6 or 12) or 0 on failure.
units.explain: Converts a \uXXXX escape (or a surrogate pair \uXXXX\uXXXX) at input_pointer into UTF-8 bytes written through *output_pointer, returning the consumed escape length (6 or 12) or 0 on failure.
units.sig: static unsigned char utf16_literal_to_utf8(const unsigned char * const input_pointer, const unsigned char * const input_end, unsigned char **output_pointer)

units.name: parse_string
units.summary: Parses a JSON string literal at the buffer offset into item.
units.explain: Parses a JSON string literal at the buffer offset into item. A first byte other than '"' fails immediately. It first scans for the closing quote, counting skipped escape characters (a trailing backslash at buffer end fails) and allocating output of (distance - skipped) + 1 bytes; allocation failure fails.
units.sig: static cJSON_bool parse_string(cJSON * const item, parse_buffer * const input_buffer)

units.name: print_string_ptr
units.summary: Writes a C string into the printbuffer as an escaped JSON string literal.
units.explain: Writes a C string into the printbuffer as an escaped JSON string literal. NULL output_buffer returns false. A NULL input prints the two-character literal "".
units.sig: static cJSON_bool print_string_ptr(const unsigned char * const input, printbuffer * const output_buffer)

units.name: skip utilities
units.summary: Input-position helpers for the parser.
units.explain: Input-position helpers for the parser. buffer_skip_whitespace advances a parse_buffer past bytes <= 32; a NULL or NULL-content buffer returns NULL, an already-unreadable position returns the buffer unchanged, and if skipping consumes to the end of the buffer the offset is decremented by one so the final byte stays accessible. s…
units.sig: static parse_buffer *buffer_skip_whitespace(parse_buffer * const buffer)

units.name: cJSON_ParseWithOpts
units.summary: Parses a NUL-terminated string: NULL value returns NULL; otherwise it computes buffer_length as strlen(value)+1 (including the terminator so require_null_terminated can check it) and delegates to cJS…
units.explain: Parses a NUL-terminated string: NULL value returns NULL; otherwise it computes buffer_length as strlen(value)+1 (including the terminator so require_null_terminated can check it) and delegates to cJSON_ParseWithLengthOpts with the same return_parse_end and require_null_terminated arguments.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(cJSON *) cJSON_ParseWithOpts(const char *value, const char **return_parse_end, cJSON_bool require_null_terminated)

units.name: cJSON_ParseWithLengthOpts
units.summary: Core parser entry: builds a parse_buffer over value/buffer_length and returns a parsed tree or NULL.
units.explain: Core parser entry: builds a parse_buffer over value/buffer_length and returns a parsed tree or NULL. It first resets global_error to NULL. NULL value, zero length, root allocation failure, or a failed parse_value all go to fail.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(cJSON *) cJSON_ParseWithLengthOpts(const char *value, size_t buffer_length, const char **return_parse_end, cJSON_bool require_null_terminated)

units.name: parse entrypoints
units.summary: Convenience wrappers: cJSON_Parse parses a NUL-terminated string with no return_parse_end and no null-termination requirement; cJSON_ParseWithLength parses exactly buffer_length bytes with the same d…
units.explain: Convenience wrappers: cJSON_Parse parses a NUL-terminated string with no return_parse_end and no null-termination requirement; cJSON_ParseWithLength parses exactly buffer_length bytes with the same defaults. Both forward to cJSON_ParseWithLengthOpts and inherit its failure semantics.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(cJSON *) cJSON_Parse(const char *value)

units.name: print
units.summary: Renders an item into a freshly allocated NUL-terminated string.
units.explain: Renders an item into a freshly allocated NUL-terminated string. It allocates a 256-byte printbuffer through the hooks (allocation failure fails), prints via print_value (failure fails), then update_offset finalizes the length.
units.sig: static unsigned char *print(const cJSON * const item, cJSON_bool format, const internal_hooks * const hooks)

units.name: print apis
units.summary: Public printing entries over the internal print/printbuffer machinery.
units.explain: Public printing entries over the internal print/printbuffer machinery. cJSON_Print and cJSON_PrintUnformatted call print with format true/false and return a caller-freed string, NULL on failure. cJSON_PrintBuffered rejects negative prebuffer, allocates a prebuffer-sized growing buffer, and on print_value failure frees it and re…
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(char *) cJSON_Print(const cJSON *item)

units.name: parse_value
units.summary: Dispatches on the byte at the buffer offset to parse one JSON value into item.
units.explain: Dispatches on the byte at the buffer offset to parse one JSON value into item. NULL or NULL-content buffer returns false.
units.sig: static cJSON_bool parse_value(cJSON * const item, parse_buffer * const input_buffer)

units.name: print_value
units.summary: Writes one item as JSON text according to type & 0xFF.
units.explain: Writes one item as JSON text according to type & 0xFF. NULL item or output_buffer returns false. cJSON_NULL/False/True reserve 5/6/5 bytes via ensure and strcpy the literal; ensure failure returns false.
units.sig: static cJSON_bool print_value(const cJSON * const item, printbuffer * const output_buffer)

units.name: parse_array
units.summary: Builds a doubly linked cJSON list for a JSON array.
units.explain: Builds a doubly linked cJSON list for a JSON array. Depth at or above CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT returns false before incrementing depth. A first byte other than '[' fails.
units.sig: static cJSON_bool parse_array(cJSON * const item, parse_buffer * const input_buffer)

units.name: print_array
units.summary: Writes an array's children as '[elem,elem]'.
units.explain: Writes an array's children as '[elem,elem]'. NULL output_buffer or depth at/above CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT returns false.
units.sig: static cJSON_bool print_array(const cJSON * const item, printbuffer * const output_buffer)

units.name: parse_object
units.summary: Builds an object as a linked list of key/value items.
units.explain: Builds an object as a linked list of key/value items. Depth at or above CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT returns false; a missing '{' fails. After '{' and whitespace, '}' gives the empty-object success path.
units.sig: static cJSON_bool parse_object(cJSON * const item, parse_buffer * const input_buffer)

units.name: print_object
units.summary: Writes object members as '{"key":value,...}'.
units.explain: Writes object members as '{"key":value,...}'. NULL output_buffer or depth at/above CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT returns false.
units.sig: static cJSON_bool print_object(const cJSON * const item, printbuffer * const output_buffer)

units.name: array accessors
units.summary: Array lookup helpers.
units.explain: Array lookup helpers. cJSON_GetArraySize counts children by walking next and returns the count cast to int (an overflow is acknowledged as unfixable in the code comment). get_array_item walks the child chain index times, returning the node or NULL when array is NULL or the chain ends first. cJSON_GetArrayItem rejects negative i…
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(int) cJSON_GetArraySize(const cJSON *array)

units.name: get_object_item
units.summary: Finds the first child of object whose key matches name.
units.explain: Finds the first child of object whose key matches name. NULL object or name returns NULL. In case-sensitive mode it advances while strcmp differs (skipping children with NULL keys); otherwise it advances while case_insensitive_strcmp differs, which also treats NULL keys as non-matching.
units.sig: static cJSON *get_object_item(const cJSON * const object, const char * const name, const cJSON_bool case_sensitive)

units.name: object lookup wrappers
units.summary: Public object lookups: cJSON_GetObjectItem and cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive forward to get_object_item with case sensitivity false and true respectively; cJSON_HasObjectItem returns 1 exactly whe…
units.explain: Public object lookups: cJSON_GetObjectItem and cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive forward to get_object_item with case sensitivity false and true respectively; cJSON_HasObjectItem returns 1 exactly when the case-insensitive lookup finds a match, else 0.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(cJSON *) cJSON_GetObjectItem(const cJSON * const object, const char * const string)

units.name: create_reference
units.summary: Creates a shallow reference node: NULL item or allocation failure returns NULL.
units.explain: Creates a shallow reference node: NULL item or allocation failure returns NULL. Otherwise it memcpy's the whole source item into the new node, clears string, ORs cJSON_IsReference into the type, and NULLs next and prev, so the reference shares valuestring/child pointers with the source while remaining unlinkable on its own.
units.sig: static cJSON *create_reference(const cJSON *item, const internal_hooks * const hooks)

units.name: add_item_to_array
units.summary: Appends item to an array/object child list in amortized constant time using child->prev as the tail pointer.
units.explain: Appends item to an array/object child list in amortized constant time using child->prev as the tail pointer. NULL item, NULL array, or array == item returns false. An empty list sets array->child to item with item->prev = item (self-pointer marks the tail) and next NULL.
units.sig: static cJSON_bool add_item_to_array(cJSON *array, cJSON *item)

units.name: add_item_to_object
units.summary: Installs an item into an object under a key.
units.explain: Installs an item into an object under a key. NULL object/string/item or object == item returns false. In constant-key mode the key pointer is stored as-is (const cast away) and the item's type gains the cJSON_StringIsConst bit so deletion never frees it.
units.sig: static cJSON_bool add_item_to_object(cJSON * const object, const char * const string, cJSON * const item, const internal_hooks * const hooks, const cJSON_bool constant_key)

units.name: add item wrappers
units.summary: Public add-entry wrappers.
units.explain: Public add-entry wrappers. cJSON_AddItemToObject and cJSON_AddItemToObjectCS call add_item_to_object with constant_key false and true respectively (the CS variant stores the caller's key pointer and marks it const). cJSON_AddItemReferenceToArray validates array, creates a reference via create_reference, and appends with add_ite…
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(cJSON_bool) cJSON_AddItemToObject(cJSON *object, const char *string, cJSON *item)

units.name: add typed helpers
units.summary: Typed convenience adders (AddNull/AddTrue/AddFalse/AddBool/AddNumber/AddString/AddRaw/AddObject/AddArrayToObject).
units.explain: Typed convenience adders (AddNull/AddTrue/AddFalse/AddBool/AddNumber/AddString/AddRaw/AddObject/AddArrayToObject). Each creates a fresh item of the corresponding type via the matching cJSON_Create* call, adds it under a duplicated key with add_item_to_object, and returns the new item on success.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(cJSON*) cJSON_AddNullToObject(cJSON * const object, const char * const name)

units.name: cJSON_DetachItemViaPointer
units.summary: Unlinks item from parent's child list without freeing it and returns it.
units.explain: Unlinks item from parent's child list without freeing it and returns it. Returns NULL when parent or item is NULL, or when item is neither the head nor has a prev pointer (a corrupted/foreign node).
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(cJSON *) cJSON_DetachItemViaPointer(cJSON *parent, cJSON * const item)

units.name: detach delete wrappers
units.summary: Index- and key-based removal wrappers.
units.explain: Index- and key-based removal wrappers. cJSON_DetachItemFromArray rejects negative indexes and otherwise detaches get_array_item(array, which) via pointer. cJSON_DeleteItemFromArray detaches then cJSON_Delete's the result (detaching NULL deletes nothing). cJSON_DetachItemFromObject and its CaseSensitive variant look the key up w…
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(cJSON *) cJSON_DetachItemFromArray(cJSON *array, int which)

units.name: cJSON_InsertItemInArray
units.summary: Inserts newitem so that it takes the position of the current element at index which.
units.explain: Inserts newitem so that it takes the position of the current element at index which. Negative which or NULL newitem returns false. If no element exists at which the item is appended via add_item_to_array.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(cJSON_bool) cJSON_InsertItemInArray(cJSON *array, int which, cJSON *newitem)

units.name: cJSON_ReplaceItemViaPointer
units.summary: Swaps item with replacement in parent's list and deletes item.
units.explain: Swaps item with replacement in parent's list and deletes item. Returns false when parent, parent->child, replacement, or item is NULL; replacing an item by itself returns true without changes.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(cJSON_bool) cJSON_ReplaceItemViaPointer(cJSON * const parent, cJSON * const item, cJSON * replacement)

units.name: replace_item_in_object
units.summary: Replaces the item stored under a key, renaming replacement to that key first.
units.explain: Replaces the item stored under a key, renaming replacement to that key first. NULL replacement or string returns false.
units.sig: static cJSON_bool replace_item_in_object(cJSON *object, const char *string, cJSON *replacement, cJSON_bool case_sensitive)

units.name: create basic
units.summary: Basic item constructors.
units.explain: Basic item constructors. CreateNull/CreateTrue/CreateFalse/CreateBool/CreateArray/CreateObject allocate one zeroed node via cJSON_New_Item and set the matching type (CreateBool picks True/False from its argument); allocation failure returns NULL.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(cJSON *) cJSON_CreateNull(void)

units.name: create arrays
units.summary: Typed array builders (Int/Float/Double/String).
units.explain: Typed array builders (Int/Float/Double/String). Each rejects a negative count or NULL input array with NULL, creates an empty array, then loops count times creating number or string items; a per-element creation failure deletes the whole array and returns NULL.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(cJSON *) cJSON_CreateIntArray(const int *numbers, int count)

units.name: cJSON_Duplicate_rec
units.summary: Recursive deep copy.
units.explain: Recursive deep copy. A NULL item fails. The copy clears the cJSON_IsReference flag from the type and copies valueint/valuedouble; valuestring is strdup'd (failure fails).
units.sig: cJSON * cJSON_Duplicate_rec(const cJSON *item, size_t depth, cJSON_bool recurse)

units.name: comment skippers
units.summary: In-place scanning helpers for cJSON_Minify.
units.explain: In-place scanning helpers for cJSON_Minify. skip_oneline_comment advances past '//' to (and beyond) the terminating newline, or to the string's NUL if none occurs. skip_multiline_comment advances past '/*' to (and beyond) a closing '*/', or to the NUL if unterminated. minify_string copies a JSON string literal from input to out…
units.sig: static void skip_oneline_comment(char **input)

units.name: cJSON_Minify
units.summary: Strips whitespace and comments from a JSON string in place.
units.explain: Strips whitespace and comments from a JSON string in place. NULL input returns immediately.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(void) cJSON_Minify(char *json)

units.name: type predicates

units.explain: Type tests sharing one shape: NULL returns false, otherwise each compares (type & 0xFF) against one constant — cJSON_Invalid for IsInvalid, cJSON_False/True/NULL/Number/String/Array/Object/Raw for the others. cJSON_IsBool differs: it returns true when either the cJSON_True or cJSON_False bit is set.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(cJSON_bool) cJSON_IsInvalid(const cJSON * const item)

units.name: cJSON_Compare
units.summary: Recursive structural equality.
units.explain: Recursive structural equality. NULL arguments or differing low-byte types return false; unknown types return false. Identical pointers return true.
units.sig: CJSON_PUBLIC(cJSON_bool) cJSON_Compare(const cJSON * const a, const cJSON * const b, const cJSON_bool case_sensitive)

units.name: public allocators
units.summary: Public allocator entry points forwarding to the currently installed hooks: cJSON_malloc returns global_hooks.allocate(size), cJSON_free calls global_hooks.deallocate(object).
units.explain: Public allocator entry points forwarding to the currently installed hooks: cJSON_malloc returns global_hooks.allocate(size), cJSON_free calls global_hooks.deallocate(object). The local 'object = NULL' in cJSON_free affects only the parameter copy, not the caller's pointer.

units.name: cJSONUtils_strdup
units.summary: Duplicates a byte string into cJSON-managed memory.

units.name: compare_strings
units.summary: Three-way string comparison used for sorting and key matching.
units.explain: Three-way string comparison used for sorting and key matching. If either pointer is NULL it returns 1 (NULLs are unequal, never equal). Identical pointers return 0.

units.name: compare_double

units.summary: Parses a decimal array index from the start of a pointer token into *index.

units.name: cJSON_Utils.h
units.summary: Header declaring cJSON utility functions implementing RFC 6901 JSON Pointer, RFC 6902 JSON Patch, and RFC 7396 Merge Patch, plus patch-array generation and object sorting helpers.
units.explain: Header declaring cJSON utility functions implementing RFC 6901 JSON Pointer, RFC 6902 JSON Patch, and RFC 7396 Merge Patch, plus patch-array generation and object sorting helpers. All functions are C-exported declarations; the file contains no definitions.

nodes.title: cJSON Library
nodes.capability: Two-part C library for JSON: the core cJSON engine that parses, prints, stores, and manipulates JSON trees, and a utilities layer implementing RFC 6901/6902/7396 on top of that engine.

nodes.title: Lookup, Predicates & Accessors
nodes.capability: Read-side inspection of trees without mutation: object/array lookup (case-sensitive and insensitive), type predicates comparing type & 0xFF, typed value accessors with sentinel returns, and the case-insensitive key comparison underlying lookups.

nodes.title: Convenience Constructors & Setters
nodes.capability: Typed value-building layer: basic item constructors, typed array builders, Add*ToObject helpers, and set-value helpers, all composing the mutation primitives into one-call creation APIs.

nodes.title: Core cJSON Engine
nodes.capability: Owns the cJSON data model (doubly linked tree nodes) and its full lifecycle: text-to-tree parsing, tree-to-text printing, structural construction and mutation, typed access and testing, and the memory plumbing shared by all of these.

nodes.title: Memory & Shared Support
nodes.capability: Centralizes allocation abstraction (internal_hooks/global_hooks, InitHooks, public cJSON_malloc/free, strdup) and small shared helpers, so parsing, printing, and manipulation all funnel through one swappable memory layer.

nodes.title: JSON Text Parsing
nodes.capability: Converts JSON text into a cJSON tree: entry points that set up the parse buffer, a value dispatcher recursing into string/number/array/object parsers, UTF-16 escape decoding, buffer-position skip helpers, and in-place minification of JSON text.

nodes.title: JSON Serialization
nodes.capability: Renders a cJSON tree back to text: public print APIs over an internal print/printbuffer machinery, a per-type value writer recursing into array/object/number/string printers, and a growable printbuffer (ensure) backing all output.

nodes.title: Public API & Data Model
nodes.capability: Declares the library's contract: the cJSON node struct, hooks struct, calling-convention/export preprocessor setup, and every public function and macro of cJSON.h.

nodes.title: Tree Construction & Mutation
nodes.capability: Owns structural changes to trees: appending/inserting children, key-based object installation, detaching, replacement, deep duplication, reference nodes, whole-tree deletion, and structural comparison.

nodes.title: cJSON Utilities (RFC Layer)
nodes.capability: Implements JSON Pointer resolution/creation, JSON Patch application and generation, RFC 7396 merge patches, and object sorting, layered on the public core API with case-sensitive and case-insensitive variants throughout.

nodes.title: Diff & Merge Patches
nodes.capability: Compares trees and produces RFC 6902 patch arrays or RFC 7396 merge patches transforming one tree into another: deep comparison with tolerance-based doubles, recursive patch emission, merge-patch application and generation, plus their public case-variant wrappers.

nodes.title: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901)
nodes.capability: Resolves pointer strings to nodes and builds pointer strings locating nodes: token matching, escape decoding, array-index parsing, encoding helpers, and public GetPointer/FindPointer entry points.

nodes.title: JSON Patch Application (RFC 6902)
nodes.capability: Applies an array of patch operations to a document: op classification, per-operation dispatch in apply_patch, path-based detach, array insertion, in-place overwrite, and public ApplyPatches entry points in both case modes.

nodes.title: Object Sorting
nodes.capability: Deterministically orders object members via a stable mergesort over the child list, parameterized by case-sensitive or insensitive three-way string comparison, exposed through public SortObject wrappers.

hit.name: ensure
hit.summary: Grows a printbuffer so at least 'needed' bytes plus a terminator are writable at the current offset, returning a write pointer there.
